testimonials.title: Testimonials
testimonials.sub_title: People who've worked with me have something to say, and I'm truly grateful.

testimonials.headline: A reference inside the company.
testimonials.quote: Felipe Zanini is a professional who stood out in every project he worked on at nav9. Stakeholders consistently praised his ability to translate technical demands into language anyone could understand, which made alignment across teams much easier. He is also highly dedicated and focused on delivering value. He stands out for the quality of his work and for constantly raising the technical bar of the people around him. Other developers see him as someone who shares knowledge and helps the group grow, making him a reference within the company. That is why he naturally becomes a solid delivery pillar on every team he joins.
testimonials.name: Felipe Adamoli
testimonials.title: Co-Founder at Techleads.club

testimonials.headline: 100% focused on delivering with quality.
testimonials.quote: Felipe was one of the best professionals I have had the opportunity to work with, always dedicated and 100% focused on delivering projects with quality, regardless of the challenges. He cares about every stage of the development process, not limiting himself to coding. In the projects we worked on together, he performed very well as tech lead with the client and achieved strong results with the team. He communicates well and knows how to stand out in difficult moments. Felipe learns quickly and has great autonomy to lead any project.
testimonials.name: Igor Casconi de Oliveira
testimonials.title: Software Engineer

testimonials.headline: Over 1,000 visitors on launch day.
testimonials.quote: It was rewarding to see the positive response to the website since launch. The reception was incredibly warm. The visuals, the layout, the content, the navigation, everything has been praised with enthusiasm. Even my father, who took a look at the code, said it was “clean”; coming from him, that is a huge compliment. On launch day alone we had over 1,000 visitors. I receive messages highlighting the organization, the clarity, and the identity of DOVE, which has become even stronger with our online presence. I am deeply grateful to everyone involved. Without a doubt, a success.
testimonials.name: Joseph Murray
testimonials.title: Director at DOVE Research
